```yaml
name: Build Linux No-Container

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build-linux-no-container:
    runs-on: self-hosted
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ['3.8', '3.9', '3.10']
        cuda-version: ['11.1', '11.7']

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update
        sudo apt-get install -y build-essential cmake git libopenblas-dev liblapack-dev

    - name: Setup CUDA ${{ matrix.cuda-version }}
      uses: NVIDIA/setup-cuda@v1.3.0
      with:
        version: ${{ matrix.cuda-version }}
        architecture: auto
        package-manager: apt

    - name: Create virtual environment
      run: python -m venv venv

    - name: Activate virtual environment
      run: source venv/bin/activate

    - name: Install required packages
      run: pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel

    - name: Clone Flash Attention repository
      run: git clone https://github.com/HazyResearch/flash-attention.git

    - name: Build Flash Attention
      working-directory: flash-attention
      run: make build

    - name: Collect wheels
      id: collect_wheels
      run: |
        mkdir -p wheels
        find . -name "*.whl" -exec mv {} wheels/ \;
        echo "wheels_path=$(pwd)/wheels" >> $GITHUB_ENV

    - name: Upload wheels
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
      with:
        name: flash-attention-wheels-${{ matrix.python-version }}-${{ matrix.cuda-version }}
        path: ${{ env.wheels_path }}

    - name: Clean up
      run: |
        rm -rf flash-attention venv ~/.cache/pip ~/.cache/uvicorn
        sudo apt-get clean
        sudo rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
```
